A FEW HELPFUL ANSWERS

Clarity before
your next step.

Ask Mike a question ↗
Does importing goods automatically create a refund?+

No. Any potential recovery depends on the entries, tariffs paid, applicable legal basis, documentation, and deadlines. A specialist must review the facts.

Which link should a business owner use?+

Use The Client Path for an importing business. The Partner Path is for professionals exploring referrals and program participation.

Does this site collect customs or financial records?+

No. Submit sensitive documents only through the specialist’s approved process after confirming the intended recipient.
